title: Number the learners
prompt: Every learner gets a badge number, starting from 1. Write `solve(learners)` so it returns a DataFrame with one column, `id`, holding 1, 2, 3 … up to the number of learners.
rules: One number for each row of `learners`: with 5 learners, the ids are 1 to 5.
With no learners, return no rows.
hints: `learners.count()` tells you how many numbers you need.
`spark.range(start, end)` makes a DataFrame with an `id` column, and like Python's `range` it leaves out `end`.
Start at 1, and make the end one more than the count.
